provenance.description: Invented tokens and invented folio-side identifiers for software validation; no manuscript transcription.
provenance.tokenization: Each listed string is one opaque token. Null is a fixed excluded slot. Duplicate tokens, an excluded position, empty lines, and a singleton are retained. No glyph normalization.
provenance.unit_definition: Each row is a fabricated line assigned to an invented folio side; no IVTFF locus or physical manuscript line is represented.
